ModMetadata.Name: Salty's Fabricator Overflow
ModMetadata.Author: Joshua
ModMetadata.Description: Printers (Autolathe, Pipe Bender, Electronics Printer, Tool Printer and the other printer-type fabricators) hold at most 500 of each ingot type. Anything over that is ejected as full stacks a few seconds after the last ingot goes in, so you can top up and combine overflow into bigger stacks. Cap and delay are configurable from LaunchPad's config UI.
